name: Direttore
source:
"I am the Direttore of the Casino" 
"I do hear rumors in one way or another, fufu." 

The manager of the government-owned casino in Burlone.
He wears a flashy costume and always speaks theatrically.
He offers a room in the casino for the Burlone mafia to conduct business and meetings in, and is well-informed in many things.
